title: ai-grid-flexibility-research: models, audits and results for 'Efficient modes, not load shifting, deliver most of the grid value of flexible AI computing'
description: Task-power models, joint investment-dispatch model, public-data audits, provincial 2030 scenario results, figures and manuscripts for the study of AI computing load flexibility in Chinese provincial power systems. Code is MIT; derived tables, figures and manuscripts are CC BY 4.0; upstream datasets are not redistributed (see outputs/research/tables/data_registry.csv).
